FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Njeri.
   B. Yes, I am fine.
   C. Good evening, Madam!
   D. How do you spell it?

2. What does 'Salut, Kamau !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How do you spell it?
   B. Good evening, Madam!
   C. Yes, I am fine.
   D. Hi, Kamau!

3. What does 'Mon père s'appelle David.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my sister.
   B. My father is called David.
   C. My mother is called Grace.
   D. Who is it?

4. How is ê said in fête? (1 mark)
   A. oo
   B. eh
   C. ay
   D. ee

5. Which little word goes with 'douche' (the shower)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. le

6. What does 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   B. The ball is behind the door.
   C. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   D. There is a sofa in the living room.

7. What does 'Le vendredi, je danse.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, I dance.
   B. A week, seven days.
   C. On Saturday, I play.
   D. On Sunday, I rest.

8. What does 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. On Monday, I go to school.
   C. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   D. On Sunday, I go to church.

9. Which little word goes with 'ballon' (the a balloon)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

10. Which little word goes with 'bougie'? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

11. Which one should we eat only a little? (1 mark)
   A. le lait
   B. l'eau
   C. les bonbons
   D. la carotte

12. What does 'Ce sont des oranges.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I do not like fish.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. They are oranges.
   D. What is it?

13. Which little word goes with 'main' (the hand)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

14. Which little word goes with 'bras' (the arm)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

15. What does 'Demain, il fait beau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is snowing.
   B. The weather is nice.
   C. Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   D. There is a storm.

16. Which little word goes with 'pluie' (the rain)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

17. What does 'Tournez à droite.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The TV is on the table.
   B. Turn right.
   C. You are welcome!
   D. It is on the table.

18. What does 'Elle est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the key?
   B. Excuse me, where is the school?
   C. You are welcome!
   D. It is under the chair.

19. Which little word goes with 'jardin' (the garden)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

20. What does 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the key?
   B. The cat is behind the door.
   C. The door is next to the window.
   D. It is under the chair.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'De rien !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Je chante et je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'Mon père s'appelle David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'C'est mon père.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je me repose.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'Il y a du soleil.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?

2. D — Hi, Kamau!
   Salut, Kamau ! means Hi, Kamau!

3. B — My father is called David.
   Mon père s'appelle David. means My father is called David.

4. B — eh
   The circumflex ê is said like eh.

5. A — la
   douche is feminine, so we say la douche.

6. C — The rug is in front of the sofa.
   Le tapis est devant le canapé. means The rug is in front of the sofa.

7. A — On Friday, I dance.
   Le vendredi, je danse. means On Friday, I dance.

8. C — Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   Demain, c'est jeudi. means Tomorrow it is Thursday.

9. B — le
   ballon is masculine, so we say le ballon.

10. D — la
   bougie is feminine, so we say la bougie.

11. C — les bonbons
   Sweets are not good for health if eaten too often.

12. C — They are oranges.
   Ce sont des oranges. means They are oranges.

13. B — la
   main is feminine, so we say la main.

14. B — le
   bras is masculine, so we say le bras.

15. C — Tomorrow the weather is nice.
   Demain, il fait beau. means Tomorrow the weather is nice.

16. C — la
   pluie is feminine, so we say la pluie.

17. B — Turn right.
   Tournez à droite. means Turn right.

18. D — It is under the chair.
   Elle est sous la chaise. means It is under the chair.

19. C — le
   jardin is masculine, so we say le jardin.

20. B — The cat is behind the door.
   Le chat est derrière la porte. means The cat is behind the door.
